description: This file defines the PlaywrightServer class which manages WebSocket connections, browser instances, and modes of operation for the Playwright remote server. It includes methods for initializing browsers, handling connections, and version checks.

classes.name: PlaywrightServer
classes.description: Manages WebSocket server, browser instances, and connection modes for Playwright remote server.

methods.name: _initReuseBrowsersMode
methods.description: Reuses existing browsers matching criteria or launches a new one if none found.

methods.name: _initConnectMode
methods.description: Initializes a connection in 'connect' mode, possibly launching a new browser.

methods.name: _initPreLaunchedBrowserMode
methods.description: Uses a pre-launched browser, closing others.

methods.name: _initLaunchBrowserMode
methods.description: Launches a new browser with specified options, possibly setting up a socks proxy.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket server on specified port and hostname.
